title: CRIC Contribution and Review Process
summary: Defines contribution types, PR requirements, per-artifact contribution rules, review dimensions, automated checks and merge rules across CRIC repositories.
notes: Competes between DOC (process/contributor guide prose) and PRD. Resolved to PRD: dominant signals are normative requirement lists ('Must include', 'must pass') plus an explicit 'v0.1 Acceptance Criteria' section, and the path sits in the docs/CRIC-PRD-v0.1/ family. No Decision/Consequences sections and no status field, so not ADR; no endpoint/schema/protocol definitions, so not SPEC. No markdown links present; mentions of CONTRIBUTING, PR templates and CODEOWNERS are artifacts to be produced, not references to other documents, so cross_refs left empty.
